markets.rules_primary: If the total snowfall recorded in Boston (KBOS) from Nov 12 to 15, 2026 is strictly greater than 1 inch, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The nor’easter reference is descriptive only. Resolution counts all new snowfall recorded at the specified station from Nov 12 to 15, 2026 inclusive, using local calendar days in Eastern Time, regardless of which weather system caused it or how forecasters classify that system. Snowfall outside those dates does not count, even if associated with the same storm. Exactly 1.0 inch does not satisfy the strictly-more-than-1-inch condition.
markets.title: Will Boston get over 1 inch of snow from Nov 12 to 15, 2026?
